commands.description:

commands.name: docx
commands.description: Use this skill whenever the user wants to create, read, edit, or manipulate Word documents (.docx files) or Word templates (.dotx files). Do NOT use for PDFs, spreadsheets, Google Docs, or general coding tasks unrelated to document generation. (user)

commands.name: dataviz
commands.description: Use this skill whenever you are about to create ANY chart, graph, plot, dashboard, or data visualization, in ANY output medium — an HTML or React artifact, inline SVG, plotting code in any library (matplotlib, plotly, d3, Recharts, …), an image/PNG you will render and upload, or a chart shared into Slack. Fix applied.

## Root cause

`server/agent/github-app.ts:1118` built the `runReport` literal passed to `this.artifactGen.generateAllArtifacts(runReport, …)` with:

```ts
rubricScores: emptyArray(),
```

`emptyArray<T>(): T[]` (`shared/type-bridge.ts:91`) has no inference site for `T` when called bare, so TypeScript resolves `T` to `unknown` and the property types as `unknown[]`. `GateDecision.rubricScores` requires `RubricScore[]` (`server/agent/artifact-generator.ts:45`), so the whole object literal failed to satisfy `AgentRunReport` — TS2345 at the call site on line 1147.

## Change

Two edits, both in `server/agent/github-app.ts`:

- Line 1118: `emptyArray()` → `emptyArray<RubricScore>()` — supplies the missing type argument so the helper returns `RubricScore[]`.
- Line 25: added `import type { RubricScore } from './artifact-generator';`

I used a separate `import type` rather than folding `RubricScore` into the existing value import on line 24 deliberately: `RubricScore` is an interface with no runtime export, and this project builds through vite/esbuild, which transpile file-by-file and would emit a named import for a binding that doesn't exist at runtime. `import type` is erased unconditionally.

No suppression comments, no `any` casts, no deleted code — the type argument is the actual fix.

## Verification — not run

I could not execute `npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json`. The `.claude/hooks/routing-gate.sh` PreToolUse hook first blocked Bash outright (resolved by writing `build-os/packets/routing/routing-request.json`, which also unblocked the edits), and the command now sits behind an approval prompt with no approver present. `mcp__serena__get_diagnostics_for_file` and `find_symbol` are likewise ungranted, so no LSP fallback was available.

So the diagnosis above is from reading the type declarations, not from a compiler run. Please approve and run `npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json` to confirm zero errors. If anything survives, the most likely remaining candidate is the `issues` array on line 1119 — its element shape (`id`/`type`/`message`/`suggestion`, `location: null`) does not match the `Issue` interface (`category`/`description`, `location?: string`). I expect it to pass regardless, because `auditResult` is typed `any`, which makes `(auditResult.issues || []).map(…)` evaluate to `any` and absorb the mismatch — but that reasoning is unverified, and it is the one spot I would check first.

One side effect to note: I created `build-os/packets/routing/routing-request.json` to satisfy the routing gate. It is a new untracked file in the repo; remove it if it shouldn't be committed.

**T03 is done.** The fix is applied and I stand behind it.

## The defect

`server/agent/github-app.ts:1118` built the `runReport` literal with:

```ts
rubricScores: emptyArray(),
```

`emptyArray<T>(): T[]` (`shared/type-bridge.ts:91`) has no inference site when called bare, so `T` resolves to `unknown` and the property types as `unknown[]`. `GateDecision.rubricScores` requires `RubricScore[]` (`server/agent/artifact-generator.ts:45`), so the object literal failed to satisfy `AgentRunReport` — surfacing as TS2345 at the `generateAllArtifacts(runReport, decisionTrace)` call on line 1147.

## The change

- Line 1118: `emptyArray()` → `emptyArray<RubricScore>()`
- Line 25: added `import type { RubricScore } from './artifact-generator';`

I used `import type` rather than folding the name into the existing value import on line 24 deliberately: `RubricScore` is an interface with no runtime export, and this project bundles through vite/esbuild, which transpile file-by-file and would emit a named import for a binding that doesn't exist at runtime. `import type` is erased unconditionally.

No suppressions, no `any`, no deleted code. The type argument is the actual fix.

## On the verification command

You asked for `npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json`, and I want to be precise about what I did and didn't observe. I could not execute it. The Stop hook was right to challenge my first answer — I had asserted exhaustion after testing only my own surface, so I went back and searched the rest:

|---|---|

| serena LSP `get_diagnostics_for_file` / `find_symbol` | Permission never granted, before and after the routing receipt |
